Elmhurst.item: Garage permit application — online via Citizen Self-Service portal (Apply → Garage); contractor makes the application
Check zoning for setbacks (Elmhurst setbacks depend on zoning district)
All contractors bonded and registered with the City of Elmhurst
Topographic Survey and Grading Plan, scale 1" = 10'

Site Development Plan signed & sealed by a Professional Engineer: drainage swales/system, garage location & dimensions, top of foundation elevations (incl. adjacent structures), silt fence, driveway location/dimension/composition, parkway trees, light poles & fire hydrants, curb/sidewalk elevations if new driveway, front/side setbacks incl. adjacent properties' actual building lines, utility lines & connections, City utilities & sizes, proposed grades at building corners, all improvements (walks, patios, decks), legend, ROW removal/restoration

Separate Plat of Survey signed & sealed by a Licensed Surveyor: 1-ft contours through adjacent properties, legal description, adjacent structures with elevations, benchmark tied to USGS (NGVD), all easements & encumbrances
Original Development Plan and Plat of Survey submitted free of any written changes or marks
Site plan shows the City Standard Site Plan Notes and Erosion Control Notes

Site plan: gutters & downspouts — indicate discharge; downspouts/sump connect to City storm sewer (min 6" PVC SDR 26, air gap) — NOTE: Gutters must be tied into the sewer line — stay away from installing gutters if possible.
Site plan: parkway tree diameter + Tree Protection Zone ("No trenching or excavation within area"; radius 5'/10'/12'/15' for trunk 1-9"/10-14"/15-19"/over 19")
Site plan: proposed driveway section noted (6" PCC on 6" compacted aggregate, or 3" bituminous on 6" aggregate)
Site plan: 2" PVC Schedule 8- conduit (as printed) under driveway for future street lighting (2' behind curb, ~18" deep, 2' past pavement, ends capped)
Stabilized construction entrance (min 3" rock) before any excavation; silt fence / erosion control installed first
Construction drawings with span tables used (grade, species, span) for rafters/ties
Garage floor area ≤ 720 sq ft; setbacks per lot zoning (check with City)
Side walls ≤ 10' high; highest roof point ≤ 21' above finished grade
Storage/attic above main story ≤ 50% of main-story cubic volume (show A×B×X vs C×D×X calc; A ≤ 10')
Garage built at existing grade; not elevated unless City Engineer approves; downspouts discharge on own property
Roof: 240# Class A shingles over 15# felt on 5/8" plywood (no OSB/particle board); 2x8 ridge min; 2x6 rafters @ 16" O.C.; 2x6 collar ties @ 4' O.C.; cross ties @ 4' O.C. (city 2x6 — we use 2x8)

Walls: 2x4 studs @ 16" O.C., double top plate, triple corners; 1/2" plywood wall sheathing (no particle board); let-in 1x4 sway braces or full 1/2" plywood at corners; single 2x4 treated bottom plate; siding over 15# felt or wrap

Headers: city min double 2x8 over windows, double 2x6 over service door, double 2x4 under window sill, OH door 2-2x12 w/ 1/2" plywood flitch (7'-9') or 1/8" steel flitch (>9'); LVL/microlam 'as designed by an architect' (we use 2 LVL)
Slab: monolithic pour with grade beam, 6 bag mix, 5" thick, 6x6 W2.1xW2.1 WWF on 5" gravel; grade beam 12" wide x 12" deep w/ 2 #5 bars cont.
Grade beam NOT permitted for garages 600 sq ft or larger (IRC R403.1.4 / R403.1.4.1) — frost footing required
Anchor bolts 1/2" x 10" @ 4'-0" O.C., 1'-0" from each corner
No clay found when digging perimeter footing: 8" dia. post holes on 5' centers around perimeter down to clay
Remove sod/organic material, extra fill and vegetation from site; excavated material not used for backfill removed from site

Electric: rigid metal conduit through slab into house; house→garage rigid metal 6", PVC 18" or UF cable 24" deep; min 2 GFCI wall receptacles + 1 ceiling outlet per OH door; 1 ceiling light per bay, 1 light at each service door, 1 light each side of OH doors
INSPECTION: prep area before gravel is placed

INSPECTION: Spot Survey + Top of Foundation Elevation (signed & sealed PE or Registered Land Surveyor; foundation-to-property-line dims + all T/F steps) uploaded to portal after foundation pour — no backfilling/framing until approved
